Name: Asta's Portraits Marriageable Candidates
Author: AstaEckhart
Description:
Portraits painted in my artistic style,The mod includes High-resolution portraits of 12 marriage candidates 

[b][size=3]◆ How to use
[/size][/b]
1. Download these mods (Portraiture, PortraiturePlus)
2. Place the pictures in Portraiture in the corresponding folder (the path is: \Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\{the folder you named})
3. Finish!

*PortraiturePlus is essential, without it the corresponding seasonal portraits will not be displayed
*If you don’t need the seasonal portrait, you can ignore this and delete the seasonal portrait PNG
*If you have installed other avatar mods for the same character, please check for conflicts.
